summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The npm package @ornikar/rollup-config@11.1.5 declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temporary directory and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and per-call string-key maps that hide control flow, and `math_init.js` is a string-array plus rotation-decoder payload (large hex/decimal token array `n7gIxM`, rotator `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`) that is not source-readable. The package advertises itself as a Rollup configuration helper and has no functional reason to fetch and load an alternate JavaScript runtime. Executing the obfuscated bundle under a freshly-downloaded runtime at install time bypasses scanners and hooks that operate against Node, and executes attacker-controlled bytes on the installer's machine before any consumer code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
